senses.gloss: m. (בּוּשׁ) bashful, chaste; chaste person, bashful man.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 20a:12">Ned. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>סימן יפה באדם שהוא ב׳</he> it is a favorable indication in a man that he is bashful.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:5">Ab. II, 5</cite>. <he>הב׳</he> he who is ashamed (to ask questions at school); a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="B00605"><he>בַּיְישָׁנִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00605"><he>בַּיְישָׁנִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:7:3">Y. Snh. VI, 23ᵈ</cite> <he>בויישנין</he>(?); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 8">Num. R. s. 8</cite>; Midr. Sam. ch. XXVIII; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:15">Midr. Till. to Ps. I</cite>.
